cards.name: Celestine, Radiant Dragon
cards.text: A dragon born from the first dawn. Its scales scatter starlight, and its breath can unmake mountains.

cards.name: Lumen Sentinel
cards.text: A knight sworn to the lighthouse citadel. Its blade is forged from a captured sunbeam.

cards.name: Skyreach Hawk
cards.text: It rides the jet streams above the clouds and strikes before its shadow touches the ground.

cards.name: Thornback Golem
cards.text: Ancient brambles grew through this sleeping guardian until stone and thorn became one.

cards.name: Prism Fairy
cards.text: Wherever it flutters, light splits into every color at once.

cards.name: Ember Drake
cards.text: A young drake that nests in cooling lava. Its sneezes have toppled watchtowers.

cards.name: Nyxar, Void Sorcerer
cards.text: A sorcerer who studied the silence between stars, and returned speaking its language.

cards.name: Gloom Imp
cards.text: It giggles in empty hallways and steals the last candle in every house.

cards.name: Abyssal Serpent
cards.text: Sailors claim the tide is just this serpent breathing in its sleep.

cards.name: Grave Knight
cards.text: Its oath outlived its body. Its armor still marches to a war that ended centuries ago.

cards.name: Shade Apprentice
cards.text: A student of the void arts who has learned exactly enough to be dangerous.

cards.name: Obsidian Wyrm
cards.text: Forged in a volcano that erupts only during eclipses. Its flame burns black at the core.

cards.name: Aegis Gryphon Knight
cards.text: Fusion (Level 7+): Lumen Sentinel + Skyreach Hawk. When knight and hawk swear the same oath, the sky itself takes up arms.

cards.name: Umbral Expanse
cards.text: All DARK monsters gain 300 ATK and DEF.

cards.name: Magmaw Wyvern
cards.text: Its roar cracks open the earth so it can drink the magma beneath.

cards.name: Pyre Hatchling
cards.text: Still learning to breathe fire. Mostly it breathes warm smoke and hiccups.

cards.name: Flamecrest Knight
cards.text: Its plume is a living flame that never goes out, even in the rain.

cards.name: Cinder Imp
cards.text: It juggles embers it stole from blacksmiths' forges.

cards.name: Phoenix Kestrel
cards.text: Wherever it lands, the grass is left warm for an hour.

cards.name: Tidequeen Leviathan
cards.text: The ocean's oldest monarch. Storms bow to the sound of her voice.

cards.name: Coral Sentinel
cards.text: A reef that slowly stood up. Fish still live inside it.

cards.name: Reef Sprite
cards.text: It paints the coral with colours borrowed from the sunset.

cards.name: Storm Petrel
cards.text: Sailors say that when it sings, a wave three times taller follows.

cards.name: Deepsea Oracle
cards.text: She reads the future in the currents, and rarely likes what she sees.

cards.name: Granite Colossus
cards.text: A mountain that learned to walk. Each step is felt three valleys away.

cards.name: Quarry Knight
cards.text: Its shield was cut from the same stone as the first castle wall.

cards.name: Moss Serpent
cards.text: It sleeps for decades at a time, so long that forests grow on its back.

cards.name: Pebble Imp
cards.text: It throws pebbles at anyone who tries to skip stones on its pond.

cards.name: Boulder Drake
cards.text: It sheds its stony scales once a year, and villagers build houses from them.

cards.name: The Umbral Empress
cards.text: She rules a kingdom no map shows, where the sun has never been invited.

cards.name: Nightmare Wyrm
cards.text: It feeds on bad dreams, and has never once gone hungry.

cards.name: Dread Revenant
cards.text: A general who refused to stay buried. His army is still looking for him.

cards.name: Shade Bat
cards.text: It hangs from the ceiling of the Empress's throne room, listening.

cards.name: Wraith Raven
cards.text: Its shadow arrives a moment before it does. So does the cold.

cards.name: Crystal Seraph
cards.text: The Puppeteer's masterpiece. Its strings are made of light.

cards.name: Mirror Knight
cards.text: Strike it and you will only see yourself in the pieces.

cards.name: Shard Sprite
cards.text: A splinter of a broken chandelier, still dancing to old music.

cards.name: Prism Golem
cards.text: Light that enters it never leaves the same colour.

cards.name: Gilded Wyrm
cards.text: The Collector's prize. Its hoard is said to include several smaller dragons.

cards.name: Vault Golem
cards.text: It guards the vault so well that it has forgotten what is inside.

cards.name: Relic Hunter
cards.text: It has never failed to bring back what it was sent for. Never asks why.

cards.name: Curio Imp
cards.text: It catalogues everything it steals, with very neat handwriting.
